entry.title: polish(ui): damped curve + kill the second source of ghosting
entry.content:
polish(ui): damped curve + kill the second source of ghosting

- #reader.page-fading used a transition; removing it tweened opacity back to
  1 while page-enter started from 0, briefly showing the old frame. Both
  phases are animations now.
- new --ease-damped cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.28, 0.42, 1): a real overshoot that
  settles back
- content entrance 0.68 -> 0.78s, lift 14px, stagger 0.055s
- page leave 0.16 -> 0.10s so the old page never lingers

entry.title: fix(ui): eliminate page-switch ghosting; add damping to entrances
entry.content:
fix(ui): eliminate page-switch ghosting; add damping to entrances

1. Ghosting: switchPage did not await its (async) renderer, so the old page
   faded back in and was swapped out only when data arrived.
   -> switchPage is now async and awaits the renderer before fading in.

2. Damping: --ease-silk is now cubic-bezier(0.22, 1.18, 0.36, 1) -- a slight
   overshoot that settles back. Duration 0.68s, lift 12px, and all nine
   entrance animations use the silk curve.

entry.title: polish(ui): apply the same entrance rhythm to every page
entry.content:
polish(ui): apply the same entrance rhythm to every page

- test page cards, option buttons, answer options and result card now use
  the shared enterFade + staggerIn rhythm
- removed a duplicate hand-written stagger loop in loadVocab that was
  overwriting the shared delays
- removed dead stagger code that sat after a return statement
- staggerIn default step raised to 0.045s to match the silk tokens

entry.title: polish(ui): silk, not snappy -- longer easing with a long tail
entry.content:
polish(ui): silk, not snappy -- longer easing with a long tail

- content entrance 0.42s -> 0.62s on the expo-out curve
- page enter 0.32s -> 0.46s; page leave stays quick at 0.16s
- lift 6px -> 8px, which reads as floating at the longer duration
- stagger 0.03s -> 0.045s
- added --ease-silk as the named curve; JS timings re-aligned

entry.title: polish(ui): retune motion -- container stays put, content lifts 6px
entry.content:
polish(ui): retune motion -- container stays put, content lifts 6px

- container cross-fades only (a moving container makes the page jump)
- content keeps a small 6px lift instead of 12-14px + scale
- durations tightened: out 0.18s / in 0.32s / content 0.42s
- stagger 0.03s
- JS switch timings now match the CSS (the old hardcoded 220/450ms left a
  gap that read as a flicker)

entry.title: fix(ui): remove layout shift on page switch; content fades in place
entry.content:
fix(ui): remove layout shift on page switch; content fades in place

- #reader no longer animates translateY/scale on switch (that slid the whole
  content area while cards moved independently on top of it)
- cards and list rows fade in place instead of sliding, with a smaller
  stagger, so text and blocks surface together rather than blocks 'pushing in'
- removed a duplicate pageEnter keyframes block

entry.title: polish(ui): soften entrance animations, add stagger to grouped elements
entry.content:
polish(ui): soften entrance animations, add stagger to grouped elements

- heatmap cells no longer animate individually (188 playing scaleIn at once
  read as the grid exploding); the container fades in as a whole
- stat cards are slower and staggered
- article/vocab lists get a per-item delay via a shared staggerIn() helper
- added --enter-dur / --enter-stagger tokens for a single source of rhythm

entry.title: fix(ui): hide timer bar outside reader; strengthen edge hints
entry.content:
fix(ui): hide timer bar outside reader; strengthen edge hints

- bottom timer bar (and focus button) now appear only on the reader view
- right-edge drawer hint is thicker and breathes more visibly
- top trigger hint now breathes continuously in focus mode, so users can

feat: translate selected sentences; make sidebar logo link to project page

1. Selecting a sentence used to fail -- the lookup endpoint only handles
   single words.

2. Sidebar logo now links to the project page (new tab).

entry.title: fix(ui): strengthen glass, fix auto-focus regression
entry.content:
fix(ui): strengthen glass, fix auto-focus regression

1. Auto focus broke because tryAutoFocus() runs on any click inside
   #readerContainer, and the vocab/article/stats pages also render there.
   Clicking those pages consumed the one-shot autoFocusTriggered flag.
   -> return early unless the active view is the reader.

2. Glass looked flat: --glass was barely lighter than the background and
   backdrop-filter had nothing to blur on a flat colour.
   -> lighter translucent surfaces, stronger borders, thicker inner shadow
   -> buttons back on the liquid (SVG refraction) filter
   -> faint ambient-light layer behind the UI
   -> modals/dialogs use the strong liquid glass

entry.title: refactor(ui): introduce button design system and unify glass treatment
entry.content:
refactor(ui): introduce button design system and unify glass treatment

Buttons had no shared standard, so radii, glass recipes, transitions and
hover feedback all diverged -- including two completely different designs
for the same delete button.

- add button tokens (--btn-h/-radius/-pad, --ease-spring/-out)
- toolbar-btn becomes the shared base; timer/action buttons follow it
- unify both delete buttons into one icon-danger style
- test options lift instead of shifting sideways
- settings modal and sidebar inputs now use glass
- remove the whole-button colour-inversion hover

CSS only -- no markup or behaviour changes.

entry.title: fix: block focus mode outside reader; make batch actions discoverable
entry.content:
fix: block focus mode outside reader; make batch actions discoverable

1. Focus mode could still be entered from the vocab page via the F key.
   -> toggleFocusMode() refuses to enter unless the active view is the
      reader; the F-key handler returns early on non-reader views.

2. Batch actions were undiscoverable: the toolbar stayed hidden until a
   word was checked.
   -> Toolbar is now always visible, with buttons disabled until a
      selection is made.

entry.title: fix: make delete dialogs actually visible; hide focus mode outside re…
entry.content:
fix: make delete dialogs actually visible; hide focus mode outside reader

1. Dialog was invisible. CSS gated visibility on .app-dialog-overlay.show,
   but the JS never added that class, so the overlay stayed at opacity:0.
   Class names also mismatched the markup (.app-dialog-msg,
   .btn-danger / .btn-primary).
   -> Rewrote with @keyframes animation and aligned class names.

2. Focus mode only makes sense in the reader.
   -> switchPage() now shows the button only on the reader view.

entry.title: fix: auto-version frontend assets to defeat browser cache
entry.content:
fix: auto-version frontend assets to defeat browser cache

Index page hardcoded ?v=37, so editing app.js/style.css did not change
the URL and Chrome (especially --app= mode) kept serving the cached
bundle.

- Inject ?v=<mtime of app.js/style.css> at request time
- Send Cache-Control: no-cache for index.html
